name: A Light in the Darkness
summary: In Deathknell, Aramis Hammerhand asks you to save newly raised Forsaken from Night's Web Hollow. Your aid may prove that those who wield the Holy Light stay loyal to Sylvanas and their people.

sections.title: A Precarious Faith
sections.body: Some Forsaken still wield the Holy Light they knew in life, though it pains their undead flesh. In Deathknell, Aramis Hammerhand and others hope to prove their faith has not set them against their own people. They use their gifts to protect the Forsaken and ease fears that they see their kin as monsters.

sections.title: Night's Web Hollow
sections.body: Northwest of Deathknell, newly raised Forsaken wander into Night's Web Hollow, a dank cavern crawling with vicious spiders. Disoriented and unable to defend themselves, they become trapped in sticky webs. Saving them brings new recruits to the Dark Lady and may convince Executor Arren that wielders of the Light serve the Forsaken faithfully.

faq.q: Who gives the quest A Light in the Darkness?
aliases: who starts a light in the darkness
faq.answer: Aramis Hammerhand, a holy practitioner in Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades, asks you to help.

faq.q: Where is Night's Web Hollow located?
faq.answer: Night's Web Hollow lies northwest of Deathknell in the hills of Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken distrust wielders of the Light?
faq.answer: The Holy Light sears undead flesh. Many Forsaken fear its wielders see them as abominations to destroy rather than kin.

faq.q: Who are the victims trapped in the webs?
faq.answer: They are newly awakened Forsaken adventurers who wandered into the spider caves before finding their bearings.

faq.q: Who is Executor Arren, and why does Aramis want to impress him?
faq.answer: Executor Arren oversees military and civic order in Deathknell. Aramis seeks his trust so holy wielders can join the Forsaken forces smoothly.

faq.q: Can the undead really wield the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Yes. Some undead keep their bond with the Light through great will and devotion. Wielding it brings immense discomfort and suspicion from their own people.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you see the struggles within your people. The newly risen may face prejudice from their own kin.
As a Forsaken priest, you walk a hard path between the faith you held in life and the harsh truth of undeath.
